Demo scene credits#

The public demo scenes on the product page, in the docs' live examples and behind the playground's "try a demo scene" link are third-party models published under licenses that allow this use. Verse Engine compiles them unchanged (scripts/build-demo-scenes.mjs); the credits below are the attribution those licenses ask for, and our thanks either way.

DemoSourceAuthorLicense
Chess set (ingest/demo-chess-set.vpk) — product hero, HDR/reflections cardPoly Haven — Chess SetRiley QueenCC0 1.0
Marble bust (ingest/demo-marble-bust.vpk) — photo-scan examplePoly Haven — Marble Bust 01Rico CilliersCC0 1.0
Antique camera (ingest/demo-antique-camera.vpk) — "classic PBR" exampleKhronos glTF-Sample-Assets — AntiqueCameraMaximilian Kamps, UX3DCC0 1.0 (the UX3D logo on the model is a non-copyrightable mark owned by UX3D)
Damaged helmet (assets/DamagedHelmet.glb) — test fixture, no longer featuredKhronos glTF-Sample-Assets — DamagedHelmetctxwing (glTF rebuild); theblueturtle_ (original)CC-BY 4.0 (rebuild) / CC-BY-NC 4.0 (original) — why it stays a test fixture only
Archviz interior (ingest/2kbaked-v9-….vpk) — production sceneA real archviz project—shown with the owner's permission; not redistributable

Poly Haven assets are released into the public domain (CC0) — no attribution is legally required, and Poly Haven asks only that you do not redistribute the files as your own or imply their endorsement. The Khronos sample assets carry their own README.md/metadata.json with the license per contributor.

Models are fetched from the sources above at image build time; nothing third-party is checked into this repository. If you deploy your own server and swap the demo scenes, update this page and the credits link in the site footer.

Material library (restyle)#

The live restyle and plan-to-home material library (web/playground/assets/library/) is 26 CC0 1.0 (public domain) texture sets from ambientCG by Lennart Demes, right-sized to 512² JPEG. CC0 needs no credit, but we give it anyway with thanks. The source asset, URL, SHA-256 and byte size of each set are recorded in web/playground/assets/library/manifest.json and web/playground/assets/library/LICENSES.md.

Test captures (not shipped)#

The scan gate (web/test/fix-verify-scans.mjs) runs on real phone captures downloaded to ~/VerseTestAssets/scans/ on the build machine. They are never committed and never served. They come from the Objaverse release on Hugging Face (allenai/objaverse, ODC-By); each object keeps its original author's licence:

FileSourceAuthorLicense
room-lidar.glb (4.7 MB)Room LiDAR · fileSeaTreyCC-BY 4.0
den-ipad-lidar.glb (25.4 MB)Den - iPad Lidar Scan · fileskollimarlaCC-BY 4.0
sendai-hotel-scaniverse.glb (17.4 MB)Sendai Washington Hotel Room 410 (Scaniverse) · filekazugoruCC-BY 4.0
broadway-corridor-polycam.glb (11.3 MB)Broadway corridor (Polycam) · filealbanCC-BY 4.0

web/test/make-scan-fixtures.py derives the other import types (OBJ zip, USDZ, PLY mesh and points, XYZ, a tilted copy, an 8K-texture copy) from room-lidar.glb. It also builds a synthetic MatterPak from the Polycam corridor: no real MatterPak bundle is publicly licensed for this use.

Verse Home furniture pack (committed)#

The furniture, decor and window view that generated homes (web/playground/plan2home-gen.mjs) are dressed with. The pack in web/playground/assets/furniture/ (6.1 MB) is committed and ships with the server; manifest.json there records, per file, the source page, the sha256 of the raw Poly Haven download it was built from and the sha256 of the shipped file (the generator skips any file whose hash does not match and draws that piece procedurally). It is rebuilt with node tools/plan2home-lib/fetch.mjs (raw 1k models and 2k HDRIs from polyhaven.com, about 80 MB, local only, recorded in tools/plan2home-lib/manifest.json) and node tools/plan2home-lib/pack.mjs (Blender: decimation, 512/256 px textures, material names from the restyle naming contract). Every file is CC0 1.0 (public domain); no attribution is required, and we credit the source anyway.
